report_parsed.summary: Within the authorized 300-second window (2026-09-27T15:12:09Z to 15:17:09Z, policy-window-1 on target m0-otel-20260909), checkout is failing and the failures are specifically gRPC Charge calls to payment. Span-metric counts show ERROR status only on checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client span (8.48 spans each in the window), while checkout's other dependencies (CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, CurrencyService/Convert, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, ShippingService/GetQuote, ShippingService/ShipOrder) appear only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET in the same view. Checkout client gRPC metrics show rpc_grpc_status_code=2 only for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (8.472) and status 0 for Convert, GetCart, GetProduct, GetQuote, EmptyCart, ShipOrder; server-side metrics show checkout PlaceOrder grpc status 13 = 8.472. Traces corroborate: payment service spans carry 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and checkout emits 'failed to charge card ... 13 INTERNAL'. Cited failing trace ids include f5e6e49ac3f1873e3954caee9c80afef, 77eebbed936ab37295df0a781f0cb3a7, 18a540addad8eb71ce0f988d05152dd5, 9c8d5db3848d4e773cb1bcbb6895f1df, 926810c6f5b5fd4a5366f26175d23300, b31c605312927fe1f04529176f16e505, d2a0d855a77d02ef32a3d6aab7b43813, 1422d7a06dd9a15c117854f5f94d9d05. Counter-calls looked healthy in this window: product-catalog spans returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with sub-3ms durations, cart spans showed no error tags with durations <=7.4ms, and shipping GetQuote returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (4.0-37.9ms). No baseline window was provided, so no latency trend can be inferred; only single-window p95 values (server PlaceOrder 221.7ms) are available. Email could not be assessed: the traces_search for service email returned status no_data.

claims.text: In the 300s window the checkout service span metrics carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR only on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (8.484) and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (8.484); checkout's oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (8.75), oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (0), oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (24.9999), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (16.2499), oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (8.75) and oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder (0) appear only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and no cart/currency/shipping/product-catalog span name carries an ERROR status in this view.

Checkout client RPC metrics show rpc_grpc_status_code=2 (gRPC error) only for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with 8.472 means the rest Charge series is 0; oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (25.0), oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (8.75), oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (16.25), oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (8.75), oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart and oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder all appear with rpc_grpc_status_code=0.

Server-side RPC metrics show checkout PlaceOrder with rpc_grpc_status_code=13 at 8.472 and with rpc_grpc_status_code=0 at 0; product-catalog GetProduct and ListProducts, ad GetAds and otelcol Export appear with rpc_grpc_status_code=0 in the same view.

Checkout trace spans flagged with error tags include oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans (rpc.grpc.status_code 13, e.g. 156384us, 130698us, 39808us, 35490us, 33103us, 32096us, 30056us, 27529us, 17028us) and their child oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans (rpc.grpc.status_code 2), on trace IDs f5e6e49ac3f1873e3954caee9c80afef, 77eebbed936ab37295df0a781f0cb3a7, 18a540addad8eb71ce0f988d05152dd5, 9c8d5db3848d4e773cb1bcbb6895f1df, 926810c6f5b5fd4a5366f26175d23300, b31c605312927fe1f04529176f16e505, d2a0d855a77d02ef32a3d6aab7b43813 and 1422d7a06dd9a15c117854f5f94d9d05; the paired prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart span in trace f5e6e49ac3f1873e3954caee9c80afef is not error-flagged.

Payment service spans error-tagged as grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carry otel.status_code ERROR with grpc.error_message/exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (stacktrace pointing at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37) on trace IDs f5e6e49ac3f1873e3954caee9c80afef, 77eebbed936ab37295df0a781f0cb3a7, 1422d7a06dd9a15c117854f5f94d9d05, 9c8d5db3848d4e773cb1bcbb6895f1df, 18a540addad8eb71ce0f988d05152dd5, 926810c6f5b5fd4a5366f26175d23300, b31c605312927fe1f04529176f16e505 and d2a0d855a77d02ef32a3d6aab7b43813.

Trace f5e6e49ac3f1873e3954caee9c80afef contains a visible chain of error spans: load-generator POST (http.status_code 500), frontend-proxy ingress (500), frontend-proxy router frontend egress (500), frontend POST (500), frontend POST /api/checkout (500), frontend executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (500, grpc error 13 INTERNAL 'failed to charge card'), frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13), checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (13), checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (rpc.grpc.status_code 2), with shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (rpc.grpc.status_code 0, 37926us) as a non-error dependency in the same trace.

Shipping spans show oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and durations 4008-37926us, and their child POST spans with http.status_code 200, across trace IDs f5e6e49ac3f1873e3954caee9c80afef, 18a540addad8eb71ce0f988d05152dd5, 9c8d5db3848d4e773cb1bcbb6895f1df, 926810c6f5b5fd4a5366f26175d23300 and b31c605312927fe1f04529176f16e505.

Product-catalog spans returned in the window show rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and durations between 85us and 2592us for oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and ListProducts (trace IDs include 54830581fc58223e3839540d78c10fd3, 0239d2886af65482f2279cc21df1b153, b6d97f93cbef1b766aad0c7c708c7ea0, 18a540addad8eb71ce0f988d05152dd5).

Cart spans show no error flags and durations of 173-7420us for oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and their HGET/HMSET/EXPIRE children (trace IDs 6d64c3584bcd2d65c215c7c57f90ced4, c92f926684fe27cddedec7798b9105e5, 7b429509c983cae51d8adbcbe96fdc75, 2b736352fd8f8b2f1ba3b1f4d52b4ac9, 18a540addad8eb71ce0f988d05152dd5); the same view also shows load-generator POST and frontend-proxy ingress error spans (http.status_code 500) in trace 18a540addad8eb71ce0f988d05152dd5.

Single-window histogram_quantile(0.95) values (no baseline available for comparison): server side checkout PlaceOrder 221.70ms, ad GetAds 23.80ms, product-catalog GetProduct and ListProducts 4.75ms, otelcol Export 4.94ms.

Checkout client-side histogram_quantile(0.95) values in the window: PaymentService/Charge 70.28ms, ShippingService/GetQuote 41.25ms, CartService/GetCart 19.75ms, CurrencyService/Convert 10ms, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 4.75ms, with CartService/EmptyCart and ShippingService/ShipOrder reported as NaN (no bucket resolution).

The business counter app_payment_transactions_total increased by 0 for both CAD and USD label sets in the same window in which Charge calls are error-tagged, so this counter does not corroborate the observed payment failures (and its 0 values cannot be read as confirmation that no payment attempts occurred).

Hypothesis that the checkout elevation is driven by product-catalog, cart, currency or shipping degradation is not supported by the observed data: those dependencies show rpc.grpc.status_code=0 / non-error status, sub-10ms p95 for product-catalog and cart-related calls, and shipping GetQuote returning 200 over its POST child, so no observed dependency error or latency anomaly there explains the failures.

The checkout failures appear to originate at the payment Charge call: error ts carry 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' from /usr/src/app/charge.js and propagate as gRPC 2 at checkout's Charge client span and gRPC 13 INTERNAL at checkout/frontend PlaceOrder. Whether this reflects a deliberately injected fault, a card-token validation issue, or a loyalty-level-dependent code path cannot be determined from the supplied evidence.
